It has high health, higher than all of the enemies that appeared before it, while being barely slower than the [[Boombox]]. It also has 30% [[Defense]]. ==Appearance== The '''Whistle''' is a humanoid whistle. It has a grey metal body and a giant whistle for its head. It wears a blue and black shirt with the Adidas logo on it, black and white pants, and grey shoes. It holds a yellow and red card in its hands. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Backyard Legends Event]] is listed instead. *The [[Assassin]], [[Trapper]] or [[Militant]] can be used to take this down. **Towers like the [[Trapper]] are also capable of bypassing its [[Defense]]. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} Whistle.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (22 May 2026 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} adidas Backyard Legends Trailer ⚽ - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Whistle''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} WhistleIconIG.png|'''Whistle''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Whistle''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''22 May 2026''' - [[v1.91.0]] **'''Whistle''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Whistle's''' [[Logbooks|Logbook]] description is completely empty. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **{{Bugfix}} [[Logbooks|Logbook]] description has been corrected to no description available. *'''12 June 2026''' - [[V2.0.0|v2.0.9]] **'''Whistle''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{BackyardBeginnings|[[Boombox]]|Wave 3|Whistle|Wave 4|[[Soccer Head]]|Wave 6}} {{CompetitionCourt|[[Boombox]]|Wave 3|Whistle|Wave 5|[[Soccer Head]]|Wave 7}} {{VictoryField|[[Boombox]]|Wave 3|Whistle|Wave 5|[[Soccer Head]]|Wave 7}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
